import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.sensor as sens

import numpy as np
import time
import math

    # Create the system
    # -----------------
    # Initialize the vehicle
    vehicle = chrono.ChVehicle()
    vehicle.SetName("ARTcar")
    vehicle.SetMass(1000)  # kg
    vehicle.SetInertia(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))  # Inertia

    vehicle.SetFriction(0.5)  # Coefficient of friction
    vehicle.SetRollingResistance(0.1)  # Rolling resistance coefficient
    vehicle.SetTyreRadius(0.3)  # Tyre radius
    
    # Initialize the driver

    driver.SetName("Driver")
    driver.SetPID(1.0, 1.0, 0.1)  # PID controls (P, I, D)

    terrain.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -5, 0))

    mphysicalSystem.Add(vehicle)
    mphysicalSystem.Add(driver)
    mphysicalSystem.Add(terrain)
    
    # -----------------------
    # Create a sensor manager
    # -----------------------
    manager = sens.ChSensorManager(mphysicalSystem)
    
    # ------------------------------------------------
    # Create a 3D lidar sensor and attach it to the vehicle
    # ------------------------------------------------

    horizontal_samples = 800
    vertical_samples = 300
    horizontal_fov = 2 * chrono.CH_PI  # 360 degrees

    return_mode = sens.LidarReturnMode_STRONGEST_RETURN
    
    # Create and attach 3D lidar
    lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor(
        vehicle.GetChassis(),  # Attach to vehicle chassis
        update_rate,
        chrono.ChFramed(
            chrono.ChVector3d(1.0, 0, 1),  # Offset pose
            chrono.QuatFromAngleAxis(0, chrono.ChVector3d(0, 1, 0))
        ),
        horizontal_samples,
        vertical_samples,
        horizontal_fov,
        max_vert_angle,
        min_vert_angle,
        100.0,
        sens.LidarBeamShape_RECTANGULAR,

        chrono.ChFramed(

            chrono.QuatFromAngleAxis(0, chrono.ChVector3d(0, 1, 0))

        100.0,
        sens.LidarBeamShape_RECTANGULAR,
        sample_radius,
        divergence_angle,
        divergence_angle,
        return_mode
    )
    lidar_2d.SetName("2D Lidar Sensor")
    lidar_2d.SetLag(lag)
    lidar_2d.SetCollectionWindow(collection_time)
    
    if noise_model == "CONST_NORMAL_XYZI":
        lidar_2d.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterLidarNoiseXYZI(0.01, 0.001, 0.001, 0.01))
    elif noise_model == "NONE":
        pass
    
    if vis:
        lidar_2d.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualize(horizontal_samples, 1, "Raw 2D Lidar Depth Data"))
    
    lidar_2d.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterDIAccess())
    lidar_2d.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterPCfromDepth())
    lidar_2d.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterXYZIAccess())
    manager.AddSensor(lidar_2d)

        vehicle.GetChassis(),
        0,
        0,
        5,
        45,
        45,
        "Perspective"
    )
    camera.SetName("Third Person Camera")
    manager.AddSensor(camera)
    
    # ---------------
    # Simulate system
    # ---------------

    orbit_rate = 0.1
    ch_time = 0.0
    
    render_time = 0
    t1 = time.time()
    
    while ch_time < end_time:
        # Update vehicle dynamics
        vehicle.Update()
        driver.Update()
        terrain.Update()
        
        # Set lidar to orbit around the terrain

            print('XYZI buffer received from lidar. Lidar resolution: {0}x{1}'.format(xyzi_buffer.Width, xyzi_buffer.Height))
            print('Max Value: {0}'.format(np.max(xyzi_data)))
        
        # Update sensor manager (will render/save/filter automatically)
        manager.Update()
        
        # Perform step of dynamics
        mphysicalSystem.DoStepDynamics(step_size)
        
        # Get the current time of the simulation
        ch_time = mphysicalSystem.GetChTime()
        
        # Synchronize the simulation
        render_time += step_size
    
    print("Sim time:", end_time, "Wall time:", time.time() - t1)

# Lidar parameters
noise_model = "NONE"  # No noise model
return_mode = sens.LidarReturnMode_STRONGEST_RETURN

horizontal_samples = 800
vertical_samples = 300

max_vert_angle = chrono.CH_PI / 12
min_vert_angle = -chrono.CH_PI / 6
lag = 0
collection_time = 1. / update_rate  # typically 1/update rate
sample_radius = 2
divergence_angle = 0.003

# Simulation parameters
step_size = 1e-3
end_time = 40.0
save = False
vis = True
out_dir = "SENSOR_OUTPUT/"

fixed_body.set_link(core.Link(fixed_body, body, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1000000.0))  # Stiff spring connection

# Start simulation
simulation = pyc.Simulation(scene, physics, renderer)
simulation.start()

# Define the orbit movement
current_time = 0.0
orbit_speed = 0.5  # Rotation speed in degrees per second

def update_lidar():
    global current_time, lidar_rotation
    current_time += simulation.time_step
    lidar_rotation += orbit_speed * simulation.time_step
    lidar_position.y() = -orbit_radius * np.sin(lidar_rotation)  # Rotate around the X-axis

# Simulation loop
while simulation.running:
    if lidar.data_buffer_size() >= 1000:
        print("Lidar Data:", lidar.get_data_buffer())
    update_lidar()
    simulation.step()
    renderer.look_at(lidar_position)  # Rotate camera to follow lidar

# End simulation
simulation.stop()
pyc.done()
